Class BaseMenuController

java.lang.Object
controller.BaseMenuController
public class BaseMenuController extends Object
This is the controller for the base launch menu. Controller intended for handling attaching the cancellation menu, tipping menu, and manager main menu. This controller makes use of 4 initialization calls for separate windows, and handles updating the order list. *

    • open_add_drink

      public void open_add_drink(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Opens the "Add Drink" window when the corresponding button is clicked. If required non-edible inventory items are not available, a warning alert is displayed instead
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggered by the button click.

    • update_add_drink_button

      private void update_add_drink_button()
      Updates the state of the "Add Drink" button based on the availability of required non-edible inventory items. If any required items are out of stock, a warning alert is displayed to inform the user that drinks cannot be added. This method is called during initialization and can also be called whenever the inventory state changes to ensure that the button's availability reflects the current inventory status.

    • clear_order

      public void clear_order(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Opens the "Cancel Order" window when the corresponding button is clicked. This method creates a new instance of the CancellationController and uses the ViewLoader to open the cancellation window. If any exceptions occur during this process, they are printed to the console.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggered by the button click.

    • finish_order

      public void finish_order(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Opens the "Finish Order" window when the corresponding button is clicked. This method creates a new instance of the TipController and uses the ViewLoader to open the tipping window. If any exceptions occur during this process, they are printed to the console.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggered by the button click.

    • open_manager_view

      public void open_manager_view(javafx.event.ActionEvent event)
      Opens the "Manager View" window when the corresponding button is clicked. This method creates a new instance of the ManagerController and uses the ViewLoader to open the manager view window. If any exceptions occur during this process, they are printed to the console.
      Parameters:
      event - The ActionEvent triggered by the button click.
